title: Compose a document workspace
choose: Choose joined panels for one continuous workspace; choose separated panels when each region needs its own frame.
avoid: Do not wrap each descriptor in another panel or AppShell. Keep md controls; domain density is separate.

ownership.state: Application owns data, navigation, permissions and persistence. Stable panel IDs preserve UI identity.
ownership.scroll: AppShell bounds the viewport; each Screen owns its region. ScreenScrollView binds to that owner.
ownership.surface: The shell/panel and shared controls own their material. Do not add a second panel surface.
ownership.focus: Use shared controls and overlay owners; do not move focus as a layout side effect.
ownership.motion: Shared owners animate; applications supply discrete state rather than per-frame React updates.
ownership.keyboard: Screen and its footer coordinate the visible viewport; the shared input/composer owns editing and IME. Do not add keyboard-height compensation in the route.

consumers: Nilo: apps/app/components/shell/nilo-shell.tsx; published pilot acceptance pending.

title: Compose a dashboard or tools screen
choose: ResponsiveGrid chooses columns from its local host and preserves children while resizing. Use chart cards for data encoding and shared HeaderActions for semantic action overflow.
avoid: Do not switch keyed chart trees at window breakpoints or measure every card height in React. A data table keeps its own horizontal scroll region; do not shrink global control size to fit it.
